extraction.NOTES: This is an administrative cover letter from J. A. Buntin, District Superintendent in Charge, to the Commissioner of Indian Affairs, dated November 8, 1928, acknowledging receipt of Circular No. 2464 dated June 18, 1928. The agency reports a list of about 80 Indians who received fee patents without applying for same, prior to 1921. The letter inquires whether information should be submitted as gathered or all at once, and whether all heirs of deceased allottees must be questioned or only a representative; one case noted has as many as thirteen heirs. No individual allottee record is described in this document. | TASK 5 RECLASSIFICATION 2026-05-03: This record was originally enumerated as CAT_1 (Sonnet missed allottee Name + Allotment), but it is NOT an allottee record — it is a cover letter from J.A. Buntin (District Superintendent in Charge) to the Commissioner of Indian Affairs dated 1928-11-08, reporting on Circular 2464 compliance. There is no allottee Name or Allotment to recover because the document is correspondence, not an allottee case file. Document type updated from 'agency_narrative' to 'agency_correspondence'. This record is analytically valuable as compliance/response correspondence and should remain in the corpus, but should be excluded from CAT_1 vision recovery batches.
